name: silvershop-suite/food-information
description: Food information for SilverShop (CMS 6), usable by any shop that sells food: an allergen catalogue with per-country rule profiles (EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia/New Zealand, Japan, Codex), contains / may contain / free from per product, ingredients with allergens in bold, diet claims, label particulars, nutrition values or an exemption, roll-up for mixed products, a product-page block and a copy on every order line.

suggest.silvershop-suite/store-profile: The shop's legal name and address are shown as the food business operator on the product page.
suggest.silvershop-suite/product-bundles: A bundle's allergens are combined from the products in it.
suggest.silvershop-suite/product-status: Made-to-order products (food made after the order is placed) are usually not prepacked.
